local E = {}
E.__index = E
local function copy(environment)
    local result = {}
    for name, value in pairs(environment) do result[name] = value end
    return result
end
function E.failure(position, message) error({ category = "runtime", position = position, message = message }, 0) end
function E.builtin(behavior) return { kind = "builtin", behavior = behavior } end
function E.new() return setmetatable({ calls = 0 }, E) end
local function checked(value, position)
    if value < -2147483648 or value > 2147483647 then E.failure(position, "integer overflow") end
    return value
end
local function compare(first, second, position)
    if type(first) == "table" then
        if first.kind == "closure" or first.kind == "builtin" then E.failure(position, "functional value compared") end
        for i = 1, math.min(#first.items, #second.items) do
            local order = compare(first.items[i], second.items[i], position)
            if order ~= 0 then return order end
        end
        return #first.items < #second.items and -1 or (#first.items > #second.items and 1 or 0)
    end
    if first == second then return 0 end
    if type(first) == "boolean" then return first and 1 or -1 end
    return first < second and -1 or 1
end
local function binary(operator, first, second, position)
    if operator == "+" then return checked(first + second, position)
    elseif operator == "-" then return checked(first - second, position)
    elseif operator == "*" then return checked(first * second, position)
    elseif operator == "/" or operator == "mod" then
        if second == 0 then E.failure(position, "division by zero") end
        local quotient = math.abs(first) // math.abs(second)
        if (first < 0) ~= (second < 0) then quotient = -quotient end
        if operator == "/" then return checked(quotient, position) end
        return first - second * quotient
    elseif operator == "^" then return first .. second
    elseif operator == "::" then
        local items = { first }
        for _, value in ipairs(second.items) do items[#items + 1] = value end
        return { kind = "list", items = items }
    end
    local order = compare(first, second, position)
    if operator == "=" then return order == 0
    elseif operator == "<>" then return order ~= 0
    elseif operator == "<" then return order < 0
    elseif operator == ">" then return order > 0
    elseif operator == "<=" then return order <= 0 end
    return order >= 0
end
local function match(pattern, value, bindings)
    local kind, children = pattern.kind, pattern.children
    if kind == "wildcard" then return true
    elseif kind == "name" then bindings[pattern.value] = value; return true
    elseif kind == "integer" or kind == "boolean" or kind == "string" then return pattern.value == value
    elseif kind == "cons" then
        if #value.items == 0 then return false end
        local tail = {}
        for i = 2, #value.items do tail[#tail + 1] = value.items[i] end
        return match(children[1], value.items[1], bindings) and match(children[2], { kind = "list", items = tail }, bindings)
    elseif kind == "list" and #value.items ~= #children then return false end
    for i, child in ipairs(children) do if not match(child, value.items[i], bindings) then return false end end
    return true
end
function E:expression(expression, environment)
    local kind, children = expression.kind, expression.children
    if kind == "integer" or kind == "boolean" or kind == "string" then return expression.value
    elseif kind == "name" then return environment[expression.value]
    elseif kind == "fun" then
        return { kind = "closure", parameter = expression.value.spelling, body = children[1], environment = copy(environment) }
    elseif kind == "apply" then
        local fn = self:expression(children[1], environment)
        local argument = self:expression(children[2], environment)
        self.calls = self.calls + 1
        if fn.kind == "builtin" then return fn.behavior(argument, expression.position) end
        local inner = copy(fn.environment)
        if fn.parameter ~= "_" then inner[fn.parameter] = argument end
        return self:expression(fn.body, inner)
    elseif kind == "binary" then
        local first = self:expression(children[1], environment)
        local operator = expression.value.spelling
        if operator == "&&" then
            if not first then return false end
            return self:expression(children[2], environment)
        elseif operator == "||" then
            if first then return true end
            return self:expression(children[2], environment)
        end
        local second = self:expression(children[2], environment)
        return binary(operator, first, second, expression.value.position)
    elseif kind == "negate" then return checked(-self:expression(children[1], environment), expression.value.position)
    elseif kind == "if" then
        local branch = self:expression(children[1], environment) and children[2] or children[3]
        return self:expression(branch, environment)
    elseif kind == "pair" or kind == "list" then
        local items = {}
        for i, child in ipairs(children) do items[i] = self:expression(child, environment) end
        return { kind = kind, items = items }
    elseif kind == "match" then
        local value = self:expression(children[1], environment)
        for _, arm in ipairs(expression.value) do
            local bindings = {}
            if match(arm[1], value, bindings) then
                local inner = copy(environment)
                for name, bound in pairs(bindings) do inner[name] = bound end
                return self:expression(arm[2], inner)
            end
        end
        E.failure(expression.position, "match failure")
    elseif kind == "let" then
        local inner = self:group(expression.value, environment)
        return self:expression(children[1], inner)
    end
end
function E:group(group, environment)
    local result = copy(environment)
    if group.rec_position then
        for _, binding in ipairs(group.bindings) do
            local expression = binding.expression
            result[binding.name] = { kind = "closure", parameter = expression.value.spelling,
                body = expression.children[1], environment = result }
        end
    else
        local values = {}
        for i, binding in ipairs(group.bindings) do values[i] = self:expression(binding.expression, environment) end
        for i, binding in ipairs(group.bindings) do result[binding.name] = values[i] end
    end
    return result
end
return E

local U = require("unifier")
local I = {}
I.__index = I
local function copy(environment)
    local result = {}
    for name, value in pairs(environment) do result[name] = value end
    return result
end
function I.error(kind, position, details)
    error({ category = "type", kind = kind, position = position, details = details or {} }, 0)
end
function I.new() return setmetatable({ local_bindings = {} }, I) end
function I:check(expected, found, position)
    local ok, failure = pcall(U.unify, expected, found)
    if not ok then
        if type(failure) ~= "table" or failure.category ~= "unification" then error(failure) end
        I.error("check", position, { expected = expected, found = found, failure = failure })
    end
end
local function operator_types(operator)
    if operator == "+" or operator == "-" or operator == "*" or operator == "/" or operator == "mod" then
        return U.INT, U.INT, U.INT
    elseif operator == "^" then return U.STRING, U.STRING, U.STRING
    elseif operator == "&&" or operator == "||" then return U.BOOL, U.BOOL, U.BOOL end
    local variable = U.variable()
    if operator == "::" then
        local sequence = U.type("list", variable)
        return variable, sequence, sequence
    end
    return variable, variable, U.BOOL
end
function I:expression(expression, environment)
    local kind, children, result = expression.kind, expression.children
    if kind == "integer" then result = U.INT
    elseif kind == "boolean" then result = U.BOOL
    elseif kind == "string" then result = U.STRING
    elseif kind == "name" then
        if not environment[expression.value] then
            local candidates = {}
            for name in pairs(environment) do candidates[#candidates + 1] = name end
            I.error("unbound", expression.position, { name = expression.value, candidates = candidates })
        end
        result = U.instantiate(environment[expression.value])
    elseif kind == "fun" then
        local argument, inner = U.variable(), copy(environment)
        if expression.value.spelling ~= "_" then inner[expression.value.spelling] = U.scheme(argument) end
        result = U.type("function", argument, self:expression(children[1], inner))
    elseif kind == "apply" then
        local fn = U.resolve(self:expression(children[1], environment))
        local argument
        if fn.kind == "variable" then
            argument, result = U.variable(), U.variable()
            fn.binding = U.type("function", argument, result)
        elseif fn.kind == "function" then argument, result = fn.children[1], fn.children[2]
        else I.error("not_function", children[1].position, { found = fn }) end
        local found = self:expression(children[2], environment)
        self:check(argument, found, children[2].position)
    elseif kind == "binary" then
        local first, second
        first, second, result = operator_types(expression.value.spelling)
        self:check(first, self:expression(children[1], environment), children[1].position)
        self:check(second, self:expression(children[2], environment), children[2].position)
    elseif kind == "negate" then
        self:check(U.INT, self:expression(children[1], environment), children[1].position)
        result = U.INT
    elseif kind == "if" then
        self:check(U.BOOL, self:expression(children[1], environment), children[1].position)
        result = self:expression(children[2], environment)
        local found = self:expression(children[3], environment)
        self:check(result, found, children[3].position)
    elseif kind == "pair" then
        local first = self:expression(children[1], environment)
        local second = self:expression(children[2], environment)
        result = U.type("pair", first, second)
    elseif kind == "list" then
        local element = U.variable()
        for _, child in ipairs(children) do self:check(element, self:expression(child, environment), child.position) end
        result = U.type("list", element)
    elseif kind == "match" then
        local matched = self:expression(children[1], environment)
        result = U.variable()
        for _, arm in ipairs(expression.value) do
            local bindings = {}
            local pattern_type = self:pattern(arm[1], bindings)
            self:check(matched, pattern_type, arm[1].position)
            local inner = copy(environment)
            for name, value in pairs(bindings) do inner[name] = U.scheme(value) end
            self:check(result, self:expression(arm[2], inner), arm[2].position)
        end
    elseif kind == "let" then
        local inner = self:group(expression.value, environment, true)
        result = self:expression(children[1], inner)
    end
    expression.inferred = result
    return result
end
function I:pattern(pattern, bindings)
    local kind, children = pattern.kind, pattern.children
    if kind == "wildcard" then return U.variable()
    elseif kind == "name" then
        if bindings[pattern.value] then I.error("duplicate_pattern", pattern.position, { name = pattern.value }) end
        local result = U.variable()
        bindings[pattern.value] = result
        return result
    elseif kind == "integer" then return U.INT
    elseif kind == "boolean" then return U.BOOL
    elseif kind == "string" then return U.STRING
    elseif kind == "pair" then
        local first = self:pattern(children[1], bindings)
        local second = self:pattern(children[2], bindings)
        return U.type("pair", first, second)
    end
    local element = U.variable()
    local sequence = U.type("list", element)
    if kind == "cons" then
        self:check(element, self:pattern(children[1], bindings), children[1].position)
        self:check(sequence, self:pattern(children[2], bindings), children[2].position)
    else
        for _, child in ipairs(children) do self:check(element, self:pattern(child, bindings), child.position) end
    end
    return sequence
end
function I:group(group, environment, is_local)
    local names, inferred = {}, {}
    for _, binding in ipairs(group.bindings) do
        if names[binding.name] then I.error("duplicate_let", binding.position, { name = binding.name }) end
        names[binding.name] = true
        if group.rec_position and binding.expression.kind ~= "fun" then
            I.error("recursive_function", binding.position, { name = binding.name })
        end
    end
    if not group.rec_position then
        for i, binding in ipairs(group.bindings) do inferred[i] = self:expression(binding.expression, environment) end
    else
        local recursive = copy(environment)
        for i, binding in ipairs(group.bindings) do
            inferred[i] = U.variable()
            recursive[binding.name] = U.scheme(inferred[i])
        end
        for i, binding in ipairs(group.bindings) do
            local found = self:expression(binding.expression, recursive)
            self:check(inferred[i], found, binding.position)
        end
    end
    local result = copy(environment)
    for i, binding in ipairs(group.bindings) do
        binding.scheme = U.generalize(inferred[i], environment)
        result[binding.name] = binding.scheme
        if is_local then self.local_bindings[#self.local_bindings + 1] = binding end
    end
    return result
end
return I

local M = {}
local keywords, symbols = {}, {}
for word in ("let rec and in fun if then else match with true false mod val"):gmatch("%S+") do keywords[word] = true end
for word in (";; -> :: : || && <= >= <> ; = < > + - * / ^ ( ) [ ] , |"):gmatch("%S+") do symbols[word] = true end

function M.is_name(token) return token.kind == "identifier" and token.spelling ~= "_" end
function M.tokenize(source, filename)
    local tokens, index, line, column = {}, 1, 1, 1
    while index <= #source do
        local start, position = index, { filename, line, column }
        local ch, kind, value = source:sub(index, index)
        if ch == " " or ch == "\n" then index = index + 1
        elseif source:sub(index, index + 1) == "(*" then
            local close = source:find("*)", index + 2, true)
            if close then index = close + 2
            else kind, value, index = "invalid", "unterminated comment", #source + 1 end
        elseif ch:match("[0-9]") then
            local run = source:sub(index):match("^[0-9]+")
            index = index + #run
            local digits = run:gsub("^0+", "")
            if digits == "" then digits = "0" end
            if #digits > 10 or (#digits == 10 and digits > "2147483647") then
                kind, value = "invalid", "integer literal too large"
            else kind, value = "integer", tonumber(digits) end
        elseif ch:match("[A-Za-z_]") then
            value = source:sub(index):match("^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9']*")
            index, kind = index + #value, keywords[value] and value or "identifier"
        elseif ch == "'" and source:sub(index + 1, index + 1):match("[a-z]") then
            value = source:sub(index):match("^'[a-z][A-Za-z_0-9]*")
            index, kind = index + #value, "type_variable"
        elseif ch == '"' then
            index = index + 1
            local decoded, invalid = {}, false
            while index <= #source and source:sub(index, index) ~= '"' and source:sub(index, index) ~= "\n" do
                local current, next_ch = source:sub(index, index), source:sub(index + 1, index + 1)
                if current == "\\" and next_ch ~= "" and next_ch ~= "\n" then
                    if escapes[next_ch] then decoded[#decoded + 1] = escapes[next_ch] else invalid = true end
                    index = index + 2
                else decoded[#decoded + 1], index = current, index + 1 end
            end
            if index > #source or source:sub(index, index) == "\n" then kind, value = "invalid", "unterminated string"
            else
                index = index + 1
                kind, value = invalid and "invalid" or "string", invalid and "invalid escape sequence" or table.concat(decoded)
            end

            local pair = source:sub(index, index + 1)
            if symbols[pair] then kind, value, index = pair, pair, index + 2
            elseif symbols[ch] then kind, value, index = ch, ch, index + 1
            else kind, value, index = "invalid", "illegal character '" .. ch .. "'", index + 1 end
        end

        if kind then tokens[#tokens + 1] = { kind = kind, spelling = consumed, value = value, position = position } end

        else column = column + #consumed end
    end

    return tokens
end

local lexer = require("lexer")
local Parser = require("parser")
local U = require("unifier")
local Inferencer = require("inference")
local Evaluator = require("evaluator")
local function copy(source)
    local result = {}
    for key, value in pairs(source) do result[key] = value end
    return result
end
local function position_less(a, b)
    return a[2] < b[2] or (a[2] == b[2] and a[3] < b[3])
end
local function print_value(value)
    local kind = type(value)
    if kind == "boolean" then return value and "true" or "false"
    elseif kind == "number" then return tostring(value)
    elseif kind == "string" then
        local escaped = value:gsub("\\", "\\\\"):gsub('"', '\\"'):gsub("\n", "\\n"):gsub("\t", "\\t")
        return '"' .. escaped .. '"'
    elseif value.kind == "pair" then return "(" .. print_value(value.items[1]) .. ", " .. print_value(value.items[2]) .. ")"
    elseif value.kind == "list" then
        local parts = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(value.items) do parts[#parts + 1] = print_value(item) end
        return "[" .. table.concat(parts, "; ") .. "]"
    end

local function type_printer(quantified)
    local names, count = {}, 0

        value = U.resolve(value)
        if value.kind == "variable" then
            if not names[value] then
                local prefix = quantified and not quantified[value] and "'_" or "'"
                names[value] = prefix .. string.char(97 + count % 26) .. (count >= 26 and tostring(count // 26) or "")
                count = count + 1
            end
            return names[value]
        end
        if value.kind == "int" or value.kind == "bool" or value.kind == "string" then return value.kind end
        local first = U.resolve(value.children[1])
        local left = render(first)
        if value.kind == "list" then
            if first.kind == "pair" or first.kind == "function" then left = "(" .. left .. ")" end
            return left .. " list"
        end
        local second = U.resolve(value.children[2])
        local right = render(second)
        if value.kind == "pair" then
            if first.kind == "pair" or first.kind == "function" then left = "(" .. left .. ")" end
            if second.kind == "pair" or second.kind == "function" then right = "(" .. right .. ")" end
            return left .. " * " .. right
        end
        if first.kind == "function" then left = "(" .. left .. ")" end

    end

end
local function format_declared_type(expression)

    if kind == "int" or kind == "bool" or kind == "string" then return kind end
    local first = expression.children[1]
    local left = format_declared_type(first)
    if kind == "list" then
        if first.kind == "pair" or first.kind == "function" then left = "(" .. left .. ")" end
        return left .. " list"
    end
    local second = expression.children[2]
    local right = format_declared_type(second)
    if kind == "pair" then
        if first.kind == "pair" or first.kind == "function" then left = "(" .. left .. ")" end
        if second.kind == "pair" or second.kind == "function" then right = "(" .. right .. ")" end
        return left .. " * " .. right
    end
    if first.kind == "function" then left = "(" .. left .. ")" end
    return left .. " -> " .. right
end
local function signature_type(expression, variables)
    if expression.kind == "type_variable" then
        if not variables[expression.value] then variables[expression.value] = U.variable() end
        return variables[expression.value]
    end
    local result = U.type(expression.kind)
    for i, child in ipairs(expression.children) do result.children[i] = signature_type(child, variables) end

    if first.kind ~= second.kind then return false end
    for i, child in ipairs(first.children) do if not identical(child, second.children[i]) then return false end end

        if assignments[inferred] then return identical(assignments[inferred], declared) end
        assignments[inferred] = declared
        return true
    end
    if declared.kind == "variable" or inferred.kind ~= declared.kind then return false end

    end

    for i, binding in ipairs(group.bindings) do

            if not signature_matches(inferred, declared, {}) then
                Inferencer.error("signature", binding.position, { name = binding.name, inferred = inferred, declared = declared })

        local current = { [0] = i }
        for j = 1, #second do
            current[j] = math.min(current[j - 1] + 1, previous[j] + 1,
                previous[j - 1] + (first:sub(i, i) == second:sub(j, j) and 0 or 1))
        end

local function type_error_message(err)

        for _, candidate in ipairs(details.candidates) do
            local d = distance(details.name, candidate)
            if d <= 2 and d < #details.name and (d < best_distance or (d == best_distance and candidate < best)) then
                best, best_distance = candidate, d
            end

        return message
    elseif err.kind == "not_function" then return "expected a function but found " .. render(details.found)

            if variable.kind ~= "variable" then variable, value = value, variable end
            local variable_text, value_text = render(variable), render(value)
            message = message .. " (infinite type " .. variable_text .. " = " .. value_text .. ")"
        elseif failure.nested then
            local first, second = render(failure.expected), render(failure.found)
            message = message .. " (" .. first .. " vs " .. second .. ")"

    elseif err.kind == "duplicate_let" then return "variable '" .. details.name .. "' is bound twice in this let"
    elseif err.kind == "recursive_function" then return "'" .. details.name .. "' in let rec must be a function" end

end
local function builtins()

    local fst = U.scheme(U.type("function", U.type("pair", first, second), first), { [first] = true, [second] = true })
    first, second = U.variable(), U.variable()
    local snd = U.scheme(U.type("function", U.type("pair", first, second), second), { [first] = true, [second] = true })
    local result = U.variable()
    local types = { fst = fst, snd = snd, ["not"] = U.scheme(U.type("function", U.BOOL, U.BOOL)),
        string_of_int = U.scheme(U.type("function", U.INT, U.STRING)),
        failwith = U.scheme(U.type("function", U.STRING, result), { [result] = true }) }
    local values = { fst = Evaluator.builtin(function(value) return value.items[1] end),
        snd = Evaluator.builtin(function(value) return value.items[2] end),
        ["not"] = Evaluator.builtin(function(value) return not value end),
        string_of_int = Evaluator.builtin(function(value) return tostring(value) end),
        failwith = Evaluator.builtin(function(value, position) Evaluator.failure(position, "failure " .. print_value(value)) end) }
    return types, values
end
local function leading_parameters(expression)

    end
    return parameters, expression
end
local format_expression

        local parts = { binding.name }
        for _, parameter in ipairs(parameters) do parts[#parts + 1] = parameter end
        parts[#parts + 1], parts[#parts + 2] = "=", format_expression(body, 0)

            { expression, self:binary(op[2] and op[1] or op[1] + 1) }, token)
    end
    return expression
end
function P:starts_atom()
    local tok = self:peek()
    return tok.kind == "integer" or tok.kind == "string" or tok.kind == "true" or tok.kind == "false"
        or tok.kind == "(" or tok.kind == "[" or lexer.is_name(tok)
end
function P:unary()
    local operator = self:accept("-")
    if operator then return node("negate", operator.position, { self:unary() }, operator) end
    local expression = self:atom()
    while self:starts_atom() do expression = node("apply", expression.position, { expression, self:atom() }) end
    return expression
end
function P:atom()
    local tok = self:peek()
    if tok.kind == "integer" or tok.kind == "string" then
        self.index = self.index + 1
        return node(tok.kind, tok.position, {}, tok.value)
    elseif tok.kind == "true" or tok.kind == "false" then
        self.index = self.index + 1
        return node("boolean", tok.position, {}, tok.kind == "true")
    elseif lexer.is_name(tok) then
        self.index = self.index + 1
        return node("name", tok.position, {}, tok.spelling)
    elseif self:accept("(") then
        local first = self:expression()
        if self:accept(",") then
            local second = self:expression()
            self:expect(")")
            return node("pair", tok.position, { first, second })
        end
        self:expect(")")
        return first
    elseif self:accept("[") then
        local elements = {}
        if not self:accept("]") then
            elements[1] = self:expression()
            while self:accept(";") do elements[#elements + 1] = self:expression() end
            self:expect("]")
        end
        return node("list", tok.position, elements)
    end
    self:fail()
end
function P:pattern()
    local first = self:pattern_atom()
    if self:accept("::") then return node("cons", first.position, { first, self:pattern() }) end
    return first
end
function P:pattern_atom()
    local tok = self:peek()
    if tok.kind == "identifier" then
        self.index = self.index + 1
        return node(tok.spelling == "_" and "wildcard" or "name", tok.position, {}, tok.spelling)
    elseif self:accept("-") then
        local integer = self:expect("integer")
        return node("integer", tok.position, {}, -integer.value)
    elseif tok.kind == "integer" or tok.kind == "string" or tok.kind == "true" or tok.kind == "false" then
        return self:atom()
    elseif self:accept("(") then
        local first = self:pattern()
        if self:accept(",") then
            local second = self:pattern()
            self:expect(")")
            return node("pair", tok.position, { first, second })
        end
        self:expect(")")
        return first
    elseif self:accept("[") then
        local elements = {}
        if not self:accept("]") then
            elements[1] = self:pattern()
            while self:accept(";") do elements[#elements + 1] = self:pattern() end
            self:expect("]")
        end
        return node("list", tok.position, elements)
    end
    self:fail()
end
function P:type_expression()
    local first = self:list_type()
    if self:accept("*") then first = node("pair", first.position, { first, self:list_type() }) end
    if self:accept("->") then first = node("function", first.position, { first, self:type_expression() }) end
    return first
end
function P:list_type()
    local expression = self:type_atom()
    while self:peek().kind == "identifier" and self:peek().spelling == "list" do
        self.index = self.index + 1
        expression = node("list", expression.position, { expression })
    end
    return expression
end
function P:type_atom()
    local tok = self:peek()
    if tok.kind == "identifier" and (tok.spelling == "int" or tok.spelling == "bool" or tok.spelling == "string") then
        self.index = self.index + 1
        return node(tok.spelling, tok.position)
    elseif self:accept("type_variable") then return node("type_variable", tok.position, {}, tok.spelling)
    elseif self:accept("(") then
        local expression = self:type_expression()
        self:expect(")")
        return expression
    end
    self:fail()
end
return P

local U = {}
function U.variable() return { kind = "variable" } end
function U.type(kind, ...) return { kind = kind, children = { ... } } end
function U.scheme(value, quantified) return { value = value, quantified = quantified or {} } end
U.INT, U.BOOL, U.STRING = U.type("int"), U.type("bool"), U.type("string")
function U.resolve(value)
    local path = {}
    while value.kind == "variable" and value.binding do
        path[#path + 1], value = value, value.binding
    end
    for _, variable in ipairs(path) do variable.binding = value end
    return value
end
function U.occurs(variable, value)
    value = U.resolve(value)
    if value.kind == "variable" then return variable == value end
    for _, child in ipairs(value.children) do if U.occurs(variable, child) then return true end end
    return false
end
function U.unify(expected, found, nested)
    expected, found = U.resolve(expected), U.resolve(found)
    if expected == found then return end
    if expected.kind == "variable" then
        if U.occurs(expected, found) then
            error({ category = "unification", expected = expected, found = found, infinite = true, nested = nested }, 0)
        end
        expected.binding = found
    elseif found.kind == "variable" then
        if U.occurs(found, expected) then
            error({ category = "unification", expected = expected, found = found, infinite = true, nested = nested }, 0)
        end
        found.binding = expected
    elseif expected.kind ~= found.kind then
        error({ category = "unification", expected = expected, found = found, nested = nested }, 0)
    else
        for i, first in ipairs(expected.children) do U.unify(first, found.children[i], true) end
    end
end
function U.free(value, result)
    result, value = result or {}, U.resolve(value)
    if value.kind == "variable" then result[value] = true
    else for _, child in ipairs(value.children) do U.free(child, result) end end
    return result
end
function U.generalize(value, environment)
    local blocked, quantified = {}, U.free(value)
    for _, scheme in pairs(environment) do
        for variable in pairs(U.free(scheme.value)) do
            if not scheme.quantified[variable] then blocked[variable] = true end
        end
    end
    for variable in pairs(blocked) do quantified[variable] = nil end
    return U.scheme(value, quantified)
end
function U.instantiate(scheme)
    local replacements = {}
    local function clone(value)
        value = U.resolve(value)
        if value.kind == "variable" then
            if not scheme.quantified[value] then return value end
            if not replacements[value] then replacements[value] = U.variable() end
            return replacements[value]
        end
        local result = U.type(value.kind)
        for i, child in ipairs(value.children) do result.children[i] = clone(child) end
        return result
    end
    return clone(scheme.value)
end
return U
